ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) central pixels and 25% low-intensity (black) peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous central white region; solid black continuous border along the entire trailing edge and lobe tips; feathered grayscale transition zone at the internal boundary; localized dark clusters in the lower-left and central-base regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; calculated angle approximately 35 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire trailing edge; high-amplitude jagged peaks concentrated on distal lobe tips; lower-frequency undulations toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory fitted to the trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 8-10 distinct dark, circular pixel clusters scattered across the white ventral surface, primarily in the lower-central and right-central areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark V-shaped marks in the lower-left quadrant; parallel vertical dark strokes at the central base; a single thin diagonal dark line disrupting the white field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent set of 4-5 parallel, concentric curved rake marks or structural ridges localized on the distal edge of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique concentric ripple-like pigmentation pattern on the far lateral margin of the left lobe.
